hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers an afterInitialize permission but performs no logic in the callback. Pool initialization and initial tick recording are handled separately via the `initializePools()` function, which calls an external `ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper` contract. All other hook callbacks (swap, liquidity, donate) are no-ops.
